cards.prompt:
KD Coffee Homepage Scene Photography

Premium Specialty Coffee Brand
Homepage HOME003 Scene 001
First Specialty Coffee Experience

Purpose
Create a premium lifestyle photograph for a homepage scene that welcomes people trying specialty coffee for the first time. The image must communicate warmth, simplicity, ease, and quiet confidence.

Composition
Vertical 4:5 composition, 1600 × 2000 px. A warm wooden table beside a large window. Soft morning sunlight. A simple white ceramic mug with one unbranded drip coffee bag hanging naturally on the rim. Fresh black coffee slowly dripping into the mug. A closed paperback book and a softly folded natural linen cloth nearby. Main subject placed slightly left of center. Keep the upper-right and lower-right areas visually calm for website text overlay.

Visual Direction
Japanese minimalism, premium specialty coffee brand, authentic lifestyle photography, quiet morning atmosphere, warm neutral tones, natural wood, soft cream and ivory, subtle shadows, timeless and refined. Realistic commercial photography, not an illustration.

Camera and Lighting
50 mm lens look, eye-level viewpoint, shallow depth of field, natural window light, warm white balance, soft realistic shadows, no dramatic spotlight.

Important
No visible brand logo, no readable packaging text, no people, no hands, no milk foam. Coffee must be black. Large negative space for website typography. Ultra-high resolution, photorealistic, clean and premium.
cards.negativePrompt: No people, no hands, no face, no smartphone, no laptop, no office desk, no café interior, no latte art, no milk, no coffee beans scattered on the table, no flowers, no excessive props, no bright saturated colors, no text, no logo, no watermark, no illustration, no cartoon, no CGI, no fake HDR, no distorted drip bag, no duplicated objects.

cards.prompt:
KD Coffee Homepage Scene Photography

Premium Specialty Coffee Brand
Homepage HOME003 Scene 002
Choose Coffee by Flavor

Purpose
Create a refined still-life photograph that helps a customer intuitively understand floral, fruity, and sweet coffee flavor directions without looking like a fruit advertisement.

Composition
Vertical 4:5 composition, 1200 × 1500 px. One elegant cup of black pour-over coffee on a warm stone or light wood surface. Arrange only a few carefully selected natural ingredients around it: one pale peach, a small cut citrus, two or three dark berries, and one delicate white flower. Keep every object separated with generous negative space. Place the coffee cup in the lower-left third. Preserve a calm dark-to-neutral area in the upper half for website text overlay.

Visual Direction
Japanese editorial still life, premium coffee brand, art-gallery calmness, warm muted natural palette, sophisticated but approachable, authentic food photography, restrained styling. The ingredients should suggest flavor notes, not become a fruit basket.

Camera and Lighting
Top-front 45-degree camera angle, 50 mm lens look, soft side window light, realistic shadows, moderate depth of field, accurate natural textures.

Important
Black coffee only. No packaging, no labels, no people. No floating ingredients. No excessive decoration. Ultra-high resolution, photorealistic, refined commercial photography.
cards.negativePrompt: No fruit explosion, no fruit basket, no dozens of berries, no latte art, no milk, no coffee beans scattered, no artificial flowers, no hands, no people, no text, no logo, no watermark, no illustration, no cartoon, no surreal floating objects, no oversaturated colors, no glossy CGI, no cluttered composition.

cards.prompt:
KD Coffee Homepage Scene Photography

Premium Specialty Coffee Brand
Homepage HOME003 Scene 003
Memorable Coffee Gift

Purpose
Create a premium gifting scene for KD Coffee that feels sincere, tasteful, and suitable for Taiwanese seasonal gifting. This is a temporary concept image before real KD Coffee packaging photography is available.

Composition
Vertical 4:5 composition, 1200 × 1500 px. A minimalist matte gift box in deep charcoal or warm ivory placed on a clean wooden table. Beside it, a simple premium paper carry bag and several neatly arranged individual drip coffee sachets with no readable branding. A narrow fabric ribbon or paper band adds a restrained gifting detail. Keep the left or upper-left area calm for website text.

Visual Direction
Japanese minimalism, premium handmade coffee workshop, understated luxury, warm and sincere, Taiwanese boutique gift aesthetic, natural paper textures, muted cream, charcoal and soft brown palette. Realistic commercial product photography.

Lighting
Soft afternoon window light, gentle shadow, warm neutral white balance, clean studio-home environment, sharp packaging details with soft background falloff.

Important
The packaging must remain generic and unbranded so it does not falsely reproduce the final KD Coffee package. No festive clichés, no excessive ribbons, no red-and-gold luxury styling. Ultra-high resolution, photorealistic.
cards.negativePrompt: No readable logo, no fake KD Coffee logo, no text, no watermark, no Christmas decorations, no red envelopes, no excessive gold, no huge bow, no flowers everywhere, no people, no hands, no coffee beans scattered, no plastic-looking packaging, no CGI mockup look, no cartoon, no illustration, no crowded background.

cards.prompt:
KD Coffee Homepage Scene Photography

Premium Specialty Coffee Brand
Homepage HOME003 Scene 004
Quick Reorder and Familiar Flavor

Purpose
Create a calm repeat-purchase scene that communicates familiarity, trust, and an easy return to a favorite coffee.

Composition
Vertical 4:5 composition, 1200 × 1500 px. A tidy home or studio work table with three upright matte coffee bags in charcoal tones, deliberately shown without readable labels or logos. One opened bag and a simple hand-brewing setup nearby: a ceramic dripper, glass server, and black coffee cup. The arrangement should feel like a loyal customer preparing to restock a familiar favorite. Keep the upper-right area quiet for website text.

Visual Direction
Premium Japanese coffee workshop aesthetic, understated, mature, dependable, real-life product photography, warm neutral color palette, clean and organized, subtle sense of routine and familiarity.

Camera and Lighting
Eye-level to slightly elevated angle, 50 mm lens look, soft natural side light, realistic material textures, moderate depth of field.

Important
No person required. Packaging remains generic until real KD Coffee product photos replace it. Black coffee only. Ultra-high resolution and photorealistic.
cards.negativePrompt: No readable branding, no fake logo, no text, no watermark, no people posing, no laptop dominating the scene, no smartphone, no latte art, no milk, no scattered coffee beans, no messy table, no colorful commercial packaging, no illustration, no cartoon, no CGI, no dramatic spotlight, no excessive props.
